accounts.title: Claude accounts
accounts.intro: You can choose a registered account next to the model in the composer. Conversations without one use the signed-in account.
accounts.usageNote: To show each account's remaining usage on the Usage screen, authorize usage display for each account. If the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable is set, it takes precedence.

owner.reissue: Switch the claude.ai account signed in to your browser, then issue the token again.
owner.named: This token was issued by the account “{{owner}}”{{expected}}. {{reissue}}
owner.loggedIn: This token was issued by the signed-in account{{email}}{{expected}}. {{reissue}}
owner.other: This token was issued by a different account from the usage authorization{{email}}. {{reissue}}
owner.same: This token was issued by the same account as “{{names}}”. To use it as a separate account, switch the claude.ai account signed in to your browser, then issue the token again.

accounts.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? Conversations using this account can't send until you choose another. The usage display authorization is also removed.

storage.encrypted: Tokens are encrypted with the OS credential store.
storage.plain: Encryption isn't available in this session, so tokens are saved to a file only you can read (opening Pleiad Desktop encrypts them again).

flow.openLink: Click here if the browser doesn't open
flow.step1Usage: 1. In the browser, sign in to Claude with this account and click “Authorize”.
flow.step1Token: 1. In the browser, sign in to Claude with the account you want to use and click “Authorize”.
flow.step2: 2. Paste the code shown in the browser.
flow.tokenDoneChoose: Token registered. You can choose this account in the composer.
flow.usageNext: Next, authorize usage display. To show this account's remaining usage on the Usage screen, approve once more in the browser and paste the code (this is separate from the token used for conversations).
flow.usageDone: Usage display authorized. This account's remaining usage appears under Usage in Settings.
flow.failedHint: If this doesn't work, you can register via “Paste a token manually” under “Add account”.
flow.codeRequired: Paste the code shown in the browser.

form.name: Display name
form.authNote: Clicking “Authorize in browser” opens the Claude sign-in page. Sign in with the account you want to use, approve, and paste the code shown here to register it.
form.manualNote: If Pleiad can't authorize, run {{command}} in a terminal with the account you want to use and paste the token it shows.
form.newHint: Paste the issued token (sk-ant-oat01-…) as is. Saved tokens are never shown.
form.editHint: Paste only to change it. If left empty, the saved token is used.
form.nameRequired: Enter a display name for the account.

instruction.native: {{agent}} reads them by its own rules (Pleiad can't see the contents).

skill.native: {{agent}} reads its own skills folder (Pleiad can't see the contents).

reason.conditional: Only when working with files matching {{paths}}
reason.shadowed: A same-name item or override takes precedence

mcp.authRest: {{reason}}. The conversation continues without this MCP server
mcp.choice: {{n}} definitions with the same name · using the one from {{source}} settings ({{by}})
mcp.unusedDefs_one: {{count}} unused definition with the same name
mcp.unusedDefs_other: {{count}} unused definitions with the same name
mcp.waiting: After you sign in, it reconnects automatically and is available from the next reply. You don't need to recreate the conversation.

nativeMcp.unreadable: Left to the agent. Pleiad can't read {{agent}}'s MCP registrations.
nativeMcp.reading: Left to the agent. Reading {{agent}}'s settings…
nativeMcp.none: Left to the agent. {{agent}}'s settings have no MCP servers registered.
nativeMcp.list_one: Left to the agent. {{agent}}'s settings register the following server (connection status is kept by {{agent}}, so Pleiad can't see it).
nativeMcp.list_other: Left to the agent. {{agent}}'s settings register the following {{count}} servers (connection status is kept by {{agent}}, so Pleiad can't see it).

changed.note: It reloads automatically on the next send. To apply it now without waiting, use “Continue with the new content” (both keep the conversation history).

diff.noChange: The content is currently the same as at the start
diff.beforeMissing: The content at the start wasn't kept (the conversation started before this version). Showing only the current content.
diff.tooLarge: Too large to show the contents

login.link: Click here if it doesn't open
login.done: Signed in. Available from the next reply

instruction.title: Instruction files
instruction.agent: Claude reads CLAUDE.md and Codex reads AGENTS.md by their own rules
instruction.ply: Give every agent the same files
instruction.note: Pleiad provides nothing. Which files are read depends on the agent.
instruction.none: No instruction files found in this location

skill.agent: Each agent reads its own skills folder
skill.ply: Provide the list and load the body only when needed
skill.note: Pleiad provides nothing. Which skills are available depends on the agent.
skill.none: No skills found in this location

mcp.agent: Each agent connects according to its own MCP settings
mcp.ply: Connect the same MCP servers to every agent

place.defaultSub: Locations without their own changes follow this
place.confirmOverrides_one: The {{count}} item changed here is removed, and this location follows All locations (default). Conversations already started don't change.

inherit.all: All locations without their own changes

context.antigravityNote: In antigravity conversations, Pleiad manages this only when instruction files are also set to “Managed by Pleiad”. Instruction files are currently left to the agent, so in antigravity this kind is also left to the agent (if Pleiad provided it, agy would stop reading AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md in the workspace).

storage.plainList: The keychain isn't available in this session, so tokens and keys are saved in plain text readable only by the owner ({{reason}}). Reopening in Pleiad Desktop encrypts them again.

storage.sheetEncrypted: Saved as a Pleiad setting and connected to every agent. The Claude and Codex settings files are not changed. Tokens and keys are encrypted in the OS keychain (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, or Linux Secret Service).
